name: sgs/timeline
title: SGS Timeline
description: Date-based timeline with vertical or horizontal orientation and scroll-reveal animation.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Root <div> (Step 4a moved the <ol> inside it as `.sgs-timeline__list`, wrapped in `.sgs-timeline__track`, so a horizontal scroll effect can resolve a plain <div> direct child; an <ol> may only contain <li>). No `layer` declared (leaf content block, no grid/flex attrs despite align:wide/full). block.json's native `typography` support is declared here but rendered via `selectors.typography` against `.sgs-timeline__title` (render.php:258-268), NOT this root — see the `title` element below, which owns the text-cluster typography members instead. borderWidth/borderColour/borderStyle are custom scalar/object attrs (no WP-native per-side width support), verified live in render.php:143-155.

title.label: Entry title
title._note: Typography full-replacement migration (D971/D972, 2026-09-06) — the WP-native `supports.typography` support (fontSize/lineHeight/fontWeight/fontStyle) that used to paint this element via the declared `selectors.typography: '.sgs-timeline__title'` is REMOVED; replaced by the shared `TypographyControls` component (edit.js) + `sgs_typography_css_rule()` helper (render.php), scoped to `.sgs-timeline__title` exactly as the old native selector was. `letterSpacing`/`textTransform`/`textAlign` were also native sub-flags on this block's old `supports.typography` and have NO shared-component equivalent (mirrors sgs/accordion's own declared gaps for letterSpacing/textTransform/fontFamily) — dropped as honest gaps, not carried forward. No independent title colour control exists (colour is the shared wrapper `color.text`) — pre-existing honest gap. `attrMap.tag` — `headingLevel` sets the rendered tag on this element (render.php) and this element has an explicit `prefix`, but `tag` is not a CSS property so it still needs its own map entry.

connector.label: Connector line / node
connector._note: connectorColour drives the `--sgs-connector-colour` custom property, painted as `background-color` on the connector line + node dot (style.scss:64, 84-96, 236, 244-256, 316, 334) — a scoped CSS-var mechanism, not a WP-native background. No prefix declared (connectorColour does not follow the `{prefix}Colour` convention for an element named `connector`) — resolved via explicit attrMap only. connectorColourGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout) is the `--sgs-connector-colour-gradient` sibling, same `sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls()` shape already proven on brand-strip/post-grid/social-icons/form/gallery/before-after/option-picker/tabs — style.scss's solid connector-line + node-dot rules gain a matching `background-image:var(--sgs-connector-colour-gradient,none)` line; the dashed/dotted connector-style variants already override with a full `background:` shorthand, so the gradient sibling is naturally superseded there with no extra guard needed. connectorColourHover/HoverGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance FILL closeout) are the `--sgs-connector-colour-hover`/`-hover-gradient` siblings, same `sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls()` 5-arg form proven on before-after's `handleColour`; style.scss adds a `:hover, :focus-visible` pair on each of the 4 plain background-colour consumers (vertical line, horizontal line, node dot, node icon), fallback-chaining hover -> resting -> CSS default. The dashed/dotted variants remain naturally superseded on hover exactly as on rest — no extra guard needed. ⚠ connectorFillColour used to carry a `"css:stroke"` entry HERE, claiming it painted an SVG path — corrected 2026-09-05/06 after reading style.scss in full: zero `stroke:` consumers exist for `--sgs-timeline-fill-colour` anywhere in the file. Its real attrMap entry moved to the new `progress` element below, both because the manifest fact was wrong (no stroke, real property is background-color/border-color/box-shadow/gradient-stop) AND because keeping it here would have collided as a literal duplicate JSON key against this element's own `css:background-color`/`css:background-image` (connectorColour/connectorColourGradient) — JSON objects silently drop the earlier of two identical keys on parse, which would have orphaned connectorColour's routing.

progress.label: Progress fill
progress._note: connectorFillColour drives `--sgs-timeline-fill-colour`, the scroll-driven progress overlay colour — a DIFFERENT set of DOM nodes from the resting `connector` element's line/dot: `.sgs-timeline__progress-fill`/`-glow` (background-color, style.scss:89), the progress head `::after` (radial-gradient + box-shadow, :120-126), `.sgs-timeline__spark` (radial-gradient + box-shadow, :248-255), `.sgs-timeline__node.is-reached::before` and `.is-reached .sgs-timeline__node-icon` (background-color, :875,890), and the carousel-mode `.is-reached` entry border (`border-top-color`, :1671). Deliberately its own element rather than folded into `connector` — see the note on `connector` above for why a shared attrMap object there is a JSON key collision, not just a naming choice. Only the plain `background-color:` lines (:89, :875, :890) are in scope for the fill-custom-property-gradient migration; the composed gradient-stop/box-shadow/border-color consumers are left untouched as before. connectorFillColourHover/HoverGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance FILL closeout) follow the same scope: `.sgs-timeline__progress-fill` cannot receive pointer events directly (its `.sgs-timeline__progress` ancestor is `pointer-events:none`), so its hover rule is keyed on `.sgs-timeline:hover`/`:focus-within` instead of self-hover; the `.is-reached` dot and node-icon ARE self-hoverable and use the same pattern as `connector` above.

date.label: Entry date
date._note: dateColour drives `--sgs-date-colour`, applied via a `:not([style*='color'])` CSS fallback on `.sgs-timeline__date` (style.scss:358-360) so an inline colour override always wins. Resolves via default convention (`date`+`Colour`).

entry.label: Timeline entry
entry._note: Per-entry fields (date/title/description/icon/image) are plain repeater content from the `entries` array — no independent per-entry style controls exist beyond the block-wide title/date/connector colours above. `supports.sgs.imageControls` was removed 2026-08-11 (Spec 35 capability-routing doctrine) — the per-entry image renders at natural/auto size with no crop box, so object-fit/position never applied; the declaration was dead weight, not a manifest element. Mirrors sgs/accordion's `item` element and sgs/quote's `quote-body`. Task 3 (2026-08-30) maps `milestoneMinHeight`/`entryGap` here: both are genuine CSS custom-property VALUES routed via the scoped `<style>` (Spec 32), same convention as `connectorColour`/`dateColour` above. `milestoneSize` is deliberately NOT mapped — it is a layout-MODE selector, not a CSS property, and this block maps none of its siblings (`orientation`, `contentLayout`, `mobileLayout`, `connectorStyle`, `rowStripes`). A first draft invented a bare `variant` attrMap key for it; measured against the whole tree, 46 of the 47 non-`css:`/`native:` attrMap keys are `anim:*` and `variant` had zero precedent, with no reader for it in audit-element-manifest or sgs-update. Mode selectors belong in the ORPHAN:BY-DESIGN bucket the audit already uses for `iconPosition`/`tileShape`/`logoFit`/`labelCollapse`, not in attrMap. ⚠ The design doc §8 predicted these new attributes would need a cross-track `/sgs-update` reseed. MEASURED: they do not. `check-element-manifest-conformance` failed only because this element declared `"clusters": []`, so an attrMap entry on it had no cluster member to be claimed by; regenerating `attr-role-map.json` alone did NOT clear it (that map derives from the DB, which does not know a brand-new attribute). Declaring the `layout` cluster took UNCLASSIFIED to 0 with no DB write at all.

contentLayout.description: How entries line up. Replaces the old `alignment` attribute (Task 3a) — 'alternating' and 'single-column' render identically to the old 'alternating'/'left'+'centre'. 'same-side' (Task 3b) is two-sided like 'alternating' but does not flip per row — every entry places the date and content on the same side, per the `contentSide` attribute.

contentSide.description: Which side the content sits on when contentLayout is 'same-side'. 'end' (default) puts content on the right, date on the left. 'start' mirrors it. Meaningless — and hidden in the editor — for 'alternating'/'single-column'.

mobileLayout.description: How the timeline behaves at 767px and below, independently of orientation/alignment. 'stacked' is today's collapse (unchanged). 'carousel' is a native horizontal scroll-snap row, ≤767px only — inert above that width in either orientation.

connectorColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the connector line + node dot background via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over connectorColour.

connectorColourHover.description: Connector line/node background colour on :hover/:focus-visible (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). Falls back to connectorColour, then the CSS default, when unset.

connectorColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the connector's :hover/:focus-visible background. Non-empty wins over connectorColourHover; falls back to connectorColourGradient, then none.

connectorFillColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over connectorFillColour.

connectorFillColourHover.description: Progress-fill background colour on :hover/:focus-within (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06) — hovering anywhere on the timeline, since the progress-fill layer itself sits under a pointer-events:none ancestor. Falls back to connectorFillColour, then the CSS default, when unset.

connectorFillColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the progress-fill's hover background. Non-empty wins over connectorFillColourHover; falls back to connectorFillColourGradient, then none.

scrollEffect.description: A layout-MODE selector, not a CSS property — deliberately absent from any element's attrMap (see the `entry` element note). Curated wrapper around the generic GSAP scroll-effects picker: 'basic' is today's viewport/connector reveal; 'scrub' ties milestone motion directly to scroll position; 'pinned-journey' pins the timeline and reveals milestones as the connector fills (vertical only); 'pinned-horizontal' pins and slides the track sideways (horizontal only).

milestoneSize.description: Task 3 (2026-08-30). 'compact' is today's content-driven row height. 'full-height' gives each milestone a minimum height and lets its media fill the column, hero-split style — from tablet width (768px) up only; phones always render the compact size (there's no room for a full-height row on a 375px screen).

milestoneMinHeight.description: Only meaningful when milestoneSize is 'full-height'. A SelectControl-driven CSS length (see sgs/hero's own minHeight control) — never free text, so a non-technical client can't type an invalid value and silently break the layout.

entryGap.description: Space between milestones. Empty inherits today's hardcoded default (var(--wp--preset--spacing--40, 2rem)) so existing timelines render byte-identical until a client sets this explicitly.

datePosition.description: Replaces the old `showDateColumn` boolean (Task 3a). 'own-column' only takes effect when contentLayout is 'single-column' — on phones the date always sits above the title, so there's room for it.

rowStripeColourAGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the odd-row background band via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over rowStripeColourA. No attrMap entry — rowStripeColourA/B both target the entry element's background-color via mutually exclusive :nth-child(odd)/:nth-child(even) selectors, not the declared states vocabulary, so claiming css:background-color for either would misrepresent ownership (see the entry element note in supports.sgs.elements).

rowStripeColourAHover.description: Odd-row background colour on that row's own :hover/:focus-within (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). Falls back to rowStripeColourA, then transparent, when unset. No attrMap entry — see rowStripeColourAGradient's description.

rowStripeColourAHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the odd row's hover background. Non-empty wins over rowStripeColourAHover; falls back to rowStripeColourAGradient, then none. No attrMap entry — see rowStripeColourAGradient's description.

rowStripeColourBGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the even-row background band via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over rowStripeColourB. No attrMap entry — see rowStripeColourAGradient's description.

rowStripeColourBHover.description: Even-row background colour on that row's own :hover/:focus-within (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). Falls back to rowStripeColourB, then transparent, when unset. No attrMap entry — see rowStripeColourAGradient's description.

rowStripeColourBHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the even row's hover background. Non-empty wins over rowStripeColourBHover; falls back to rowStripeColourBGradient, then none. No attrMap entry — see rowStripeColourAGradient's description.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ::before ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour at render time.
